[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
The Royal Navy service register lists Edward Dennis Glasgow, official number J54313, born 21 November 1886 at Hammersmith, London.<ref>[https://discovery.nationalarchives.gov.uk/details/r/D6953230 The National Archives, ADM 188/755/54313: Royal Navy register entry for Edward Dennis Glasgow].</ref> The medal roll index lists Edward D Glasgow, J54313, for the following awards: Victory Medal, British War Medal.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/1687/records/986874 The National Archives, ADM 171/103: Edward D Glasgow, service number J54313].</ref>

== Research Notes ==
The Royal Navy service register lists Edward Dennis Glasgow, official number J54313, born 21 November 1886 at Hammersmith, London. The medal roll index lists Edward D Glasgow, J54313, for the following awards: Victory Medal, British War Medal. No relatives are named in these service entries.

[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
The Royal Navy service register lists George Edwin Glasgow, official number SS8725, born 4 June 1900 at Burnley, Lancashire.<ref>[https://discovery.nationalarchives.gov.uk/details/r/D7082312 The National Archives, ADM 188/1102/8725: Royal Navy register entry for George Edwin Glasgow].</ref> The medal roll index lists Geo E Glasgow, SS8725, for the following awards: Victory Medal, British War Medal.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/1687/records/986875 The National Archives, ADM 171/103: Geo E Glasgow, service number SS8725].</ref> He was christened on 12 July 1900 at Gannow, the son of George Edwin and Margaret Glasgow.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/1351/records/4149797 England & Wales, Christening Index, 1530-1980 — George Edwin Glasgow, 12 Jul 1900, Gannow, Lancashire, England].</ref> In 1911 he was aged ten and lived with his parents at 292 Lowerhouse Lane, Burnley.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/2352/records/22485256 1911 England Census — George Edwin Glasgow, 292 Lowerhouse Lane Burnley Lancs, Burnley, Lancashire].</ref>

== Research Notes ==
The Royal Navy service register lists George Edwin Glasgow, official number SS8725, born 4 June 1900 at Burnley, Lancashire. The christening and census identify him as the Burnley-born son of George Edwin and Margaret Glasgow. His father, born about 1878 in Kendal, was a different man. The census-derived estimate of about 1901 is replaced by the recorded birth date.
